rows.en: It sweeps me off my feet
It's kind of scary
It's nothing special

Every time a boy who comes near me, or a classmate who gives me trouble, meets with misfortune, I feel his love.
It has always been that way...
And it always will be...
{a}...?
If you find it scary, then be careful not to make Yuya angry.
My beloved sweetheart, who stands right behind me...{p}

Heh, do be careful.
Careful not to anger me, or to trouble me...
Heh heh heh...
Well, that's the end of my story.
Whose turn is it next, I wonder...?{p}

My, is that any way to treat an upperclassman?
What an unlovable child.{p}

I can't believe a girl like you is popular with the boys.
Or perhaps...
your attitude changes when it's a boy doing the asking.
Somehow I don't feel like talking anymore.{p}

...Oh, are you flustered now?
Heh heh heh, you'd be in trouble if you couldn't hear about the seven wonders, wouldn't you?
Fine.
You needn't smile for me.
I've completely lost any wish to talk...
Would you hurry along to the next person?{p}

Heh heh heh...
The truth is, quite a few boys are fond of you.
Those boys are always telling me,
"{b} {a} in Class 1-E has the best smile!"
...I hear it from them all the time, you see...
To tell the truth, I was looking forward to meeting you today.
...Well?{p}Will you smile for me?
Smile
I won't do that

Yes, just like that...
...Thank you.
Heh heh heh...
It was a lovely smile, just as the rumors said.{p}

Heh heh, just as I thought...
You're so very pretty, after all.
Men would never leave you alone, would they?
Heh heh heh...
But I'm sure a great many people will be disappointed.
It seems lots of them think you're still available.
...Not that it's anything for you to worry about.
The only one you need to think about is your beloved sweetheart...
Heh heh heh...
If you call someone your sweetheart, then you must love that person, mustn't you?
It would be strange otherwise.
You can't call someone you don't love your 'sweetheart.'
Isn't that right?{p}

Tell me, {a}...
Are you sure you can go on loving that sweetheart?
Whatever may come...{p}Whatever may happen...
Yes, I am
No, I'm not

I see...
That's wonderful.
I was once just like you.
I was asked the very same question, and I answered just as you did, without hesitation.
...I had a sweetheart like that too.
The two of us, always together...
Forever and ever...
Even if we were torn apart, he would always come back to the one he loved.
Yes...
Even if he died...
Heh, that was before I even started high school.{p}

Oh my, you sound rather unsure.
It must be because the two of you don't truly love each other from the heart.
Perhaps you haven't met your real destined partner yet...
...Don't be disappointed.
Two people meeting is a chance of one in hundreds of millions, after all.
Heh, it's all right.
I'm sure you'll meet someone wonderful.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world...{p}

Let me see...
How about Takashima from Class 3-C?
The intellectual, composed sort...{p}He's always in the library.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

...No?
Then how about Morishita from Class 3-B?
He's the ace of the handball club.
If you hear the sound of a ball on the field early in the morning, you can be sure it's him.{p}
Heh heh heh...{p}He's terribly devoted to his practice.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

...Oh, you don't care for sportsmen either?
I understand.
You'd prefer a grown man, much, much older than you.
...In that case, the target has to be a teacher, of course.{p}

Heh heh heh...
My recommendation would be Mr. Kawaguchi, the art teacher.
He isn't very sociable, but he's what you might call an artist...{p}I'm sure you'll be moved when you see him at work on a painting.
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

Oh, you don't care for teachers either?
Who else is there, I wonder?
...I know!
Sumiyoshi would be good.
He's in the same year as you, {a}, so I think you'd get along. Now which class was he in again...?
I'd like to go out with him
...Pass

Heh heh heh...
There's no need to worry.
You'll find someone wonderful soon enough.
Someone who will love you more than anyone else in this world.{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Takashima.{p}

Heh heh heh...
He's quite a catch.
If there's anything you don't understand in class or in your homework, you should have him teach you.
He explains things very patiently.
Yes, he's terribly smart.
After all, he's been attending this school for a very long time.
Heh heh heh...
When Takashima was a student, the war was on, so he could hardly study at all.
He died in an air raid, without ever getting to read the books he loved.
He wanted to study more...
Because that regret stayed behind, he still appears in the library.
Even now that he's become a ghost.......... you see.{p}

Oh, what's the matter?
{a}, your face has gone white as a sheet.
Were you shocked to learn he's a ghost?
But surely you won't turn him down just because he's a ghost?{p}

That won't do.
You're the one who said you wanted to go out with him, {a}!
I'll never forgive you if you turn him down now.
Besides... I've already called him here.{p}

He should be arriving here any moment now.
Three more meters...
Two meters...
One meter...
Now he's reached the door.
Slowly, he raises his hand..........

"Listen, he's calling for you.
{a}...{p}Why don't you open the door for him?"
Open it
Don't open it
Urged on by Iwashita's voice, I got up from my chair.{p}

It wasn't as if I seriously believed there was a ghost on the other side of the door...
...but still, I was a little scared.
"Come now, hurry up and open it for him."
Iwashita's voice sounded delighted...
I timidly reached out and took a firm grip on the knob.
Then I slowly turned it...
...Here goes!
I pulled back with all my might.{p}

The door flew open.
"...Eek!"{p}

Standing on the other side of the door was a skeleton in tattered clothes.
When it met my gaze, it clattered its teeth and laughed.
"..........☆"
I was too shocked and terrified to make a sound.
I just stared and stared into the skeleton's gaping eye sockets.{p}

Then the skeleton turned into a kind of mist and vanished.
As if it were seeping into my body...{p}

The moment I thought that, my shoulders suddenly grew heavy.
...Wh-what is this★
Every cell in my body had sensed an invisible intruder and was flashing danger signals.
Had I been possessed by that skeleton?{p}

"Heh heh heh...
{a}, the two of you make such a lovely couple."
Even Iwashita's gleeful voice sounded far away, as if it were echoing.
It was hard even to stay on my feet...{p}

I closed the door and made my way back to my seat on unsteady feet.
I didn't have a fever, yet my head was so foggy I couldn't think straight.{p}

"My, my, worn out already...
Well, he's sucking out your life force, so it can't be helped.
But at this rate, I wonder how many more hours your life will last.
Heh heh heh...
If only there were a candle that could measure your lifespan."{p}

"{a}...?"
Iwashita's voice echoed through my hazy mind like static.
"Now, let's move on to the next story.
The sixth story is next.
I wonder who'll be telling it...?"
...That's right.
While there was still some of my life's candle left, I had to hear every story...
I had to hurry and choose the next person...{p}

"You're not opening it?
...Don't tell me you're going to refuse?
I told you that wouldn't do!"
Iwashita rose from her seat and strode right up to me.
Then she yanked my arm and forced me to my feet.
"Now, open it.
You're the one who said you wanted to go out with him, you hear me!"{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Morishita.
His gallant figure chasing the ball in the fresh breeze...
And after a bit of sport, you bring him a snack while he wipes away his sweat.
...Doesn't that sound lovely?
Getting up early will be a little hard, but do your best to keep bringing him snacks.
If you do, I'm sure he'll be delighted.
"I just want to work up a good, clean sweat at practice.
It'd be the best if I had a sweetheart cheering me on."
He told me that once.
With a dazzling, refreshing smile.
...Yes, you'd never believe he was a dead man.
Oh, I'm sorry.
I haven't told you yet, have I?
Morishita died in an accident three years ago.{p}
Of course, if you just call him a ghost, that's all there is to it, but...{p}

I understand.
So you want to go out with Mr. Kawaguchi.
Yes, it'll be fine.
I don't think anyone will stand in the way of your love.{p}

After all, Mr. Kawaguchi is already dead.
Didn't you know?
He killed himself in the art prep room over the last spring break.
He slit his throat beside a canvas smeared with bright red paint.
...Oh my, {a}, your face has gone white as a sheet.
Are you scared...?
Because he's a ghost...?
It's too late to turn him down now.
I won't allow it!{p}
